_comment: Example only: attribute names and types. Create this config element in the Orchestrator client and fill in your own values there. Never commit real values.
name: goldRush-VCFOps
description: VCF Operations credentials and the target vCenter adapter instance for goldRush events.

attributes.name: opsHost
attributes.note: Informational; the REST host URL is used for calls.

attributes.name: opsAuthSource
attributes.example: <AUTH_SOURCE e.g. Local or your SSO source>

attributes.name: vCenterName
attributes.note: NEW: name of the vCenter adapter instance in VCF Operations (usually the vCenter FQDN). The original version hardcoded this.
